exact_unwired_boundaries.fact: Endpoint emits JPEG register and byte-write operations; CS88 top expects parallel metadata/start plus byte ready/valid. No adapter or register map connects the protocols.

CS88 exposes tagged 128-bit scratch memory requests and 512-bit reference-tile requests. Moonshine core owns JPEG bytes in internal BRAM; moonshine_memory owns RGB565 SDRAM accesses and scanline reads. No shared service, allocator, address map, or port arbitration joins these stores.

exact_unwired_boundaries.boundary: canonical YCbCr and validation -> display RGB565
exact_unwired_boundaries.fact: CS88 canonical output is provisional plane/tile byte tuples. A separate converter can create provisional RGB565, but it has no C2-gated commit connection to moonshine_core pixel input or moonshine_memory.

V91l validator has abstract bank outputs and gates commit/presentation on root, seal, producer, writes-drained, vblank and scanout-drained. These are not connected to Moonshine SDRAM bank addresses, front_buffer/front_valid, line service, or actual panel scanout.

exact_unwired_boundaries.boundary: host/Sunshine -> firmware CS88 negotiation and worker
exact_unwired_boundaries.fact: In the inspected production path, host/firmware use MSV1 JPEG over UDP and the JPEG core map; no joined, negotiated CS88 path connects the host sender, handheld worker and FPGA. Experimental codec/protocol/trace code elsewhere in the repository is not treated as production integration.

firmware_host.current: Host MSV1 emits codec id 1 restricted baseline JPEG at UDP 5533. Firmware protocol parser accepts that JPEG format, checks the JPEG capability register, and sends JPEG payload chunks with 40 MHz QSPI writes to E0000100 after metadata writes and remaining-byte reads.
firmware_host.missing: The inspected production MSV1 host sender and handheld worker do not join to a negotiated CS88 codec/packet path: this worker parses MSV1 JPEG and writes the JPEG core map. Other experimental codec, packet and trace code in the repository is outside this production-path finding; none is asserted to be a completed Sunshine-to-CS88 negotiated worker.

production_jpeg_memory_display.boundary: This path receives JPEG byte writes from the core register map. It is not a generic CS88 planar framebuffer or reference/scratch service; it has no CS88 decode, C2 seal gate, or software HUD receipt.
production_jpeg_memory_display.chain: moonshine_core stores a compressed JPEG in internal BRAM, checks transfer length/CRC/SOI/EOI, decodes to RGB, centers 720 pixels in the 800-wide scanout coordinates, and emits 16-bit RGB565 pixels through pixel_valid/pixel_ready/address. moonshine_memory arbitrates pixel writes against LCD line reads and connects a 16-bit SDR SDRAM controller; moonshine_lcd handles panel timing and line-bank scanout; esp32_overlay overlays separately written overlay words.

production_moonshine_endpoint_and_cdc.current_chain: moonshine_top instantiates QSPI endpoint -> moonshine_bus_cdc -> moonshine_core. `jpeg_wire.sv` is a verification composition of those same blocks, but the endpoint contract is JPEG and it stops at pixel outputs with externally supplied memory/frame signals.
production_moonshine_endpoint_and_cdc.endpoint_protocol: QSPI endpoint converts MCU pin commands into core_write/core_read, 12-bit core_address, 32-bit core_wdata/core_rdata. Address region E... forwards to core; 01... is endpoint controls/overlay; QSPI reads use eight dummy bytes. CDC queues writes across endpoint/core clocks and snapshots reads after queued writes drain.
production_moonshine_endpoint_and_cdc.register_map: JPEG-only core at E0000000: +00 magic MBV1, +04 protocol 1.0, +08 JPEG capability bit, +0c bytes remaining/credits, +10 status, +14 frame id, +18 JPEG length, +1c dimensions, +20 expected CRC32, +24 start/abort/commit/pattern commands, +100 sequential byte ingress. The firmware uses this contract; it does not represent CS88 packet metadata or reference/scratch services.
